High Acres Cell 12: unmonitored, then failing its first scan

Same grid, same area, five months apart.

Cell 12, no monitoring route in Q3 2022GHD reading of 200 ppm or more

About this graphic

Crops of GHD’s Figure 1 from each quarterly report. The yellow shading is added by Full Circle Future: it traces the outline drawn around Cell 12 on GHD’s Q3 2022 map, where no walking route crosses it, and repeats the same outline on the Q1 2023 map. The red box marks the faint “CELL 12” label on the 2022 map. Both maps use the same lettered and numbered grid.

Cell 12 began receiving waste in January 2018. Readings above 500 ppm inside the outline on Feb. 14–16, 2023: Grid Q60 41,000; HAGW1218 21,000; HAGW1209 20,000; HIGOT404 17,500; HAGW1230 15,900; HAHC1233 6,620; HAGW1215 5,710; HIGOT398 3,415; Grid W56 2,210; HAGW1229 1,335; HAGW1226 1,220; HAGW1213 1,075; HIGOT403 1,015; Grid T55 614 ppm.

Sources: GHD, Third Quarter Surface Monitoring at High Acres Landfill (Nov. 15, 2022), Figure 1, PDF p. 3. GHD, First Quarter Surface Monitoring at High Acres Landfill (Apr. 21, 2023), pp. 1–4, Figure 1 and Table 1, which states Cell 12 “began to receive waste in January 2018.” Exhibit: Full Circle Future.
